g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Distinguish Viewer, Commenter, and Editor
Permissions for Google Drive Shared Links
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-25
Permissions are divided into Viewer,
Commenter, and Editor
According to the Google Help table, a Viewer can
only view and cannot comment or edit.
First choose whether to share with
people or through a link
To show a file only to specific people, enter
their email addresses and set permissions for
each person.
Four things to check before copying
the link
① Check whether General access is set to
Restricted or Anyone with the link. ② Confirm
whether the permission is Viewer, Commenter, or…
Examples of choosing permissions in
hypothetical situations
This is a hypothetical situation for
explanation.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
